_dropped.edge: cv-lei-financas-locais-79-2005 -> cv-lei-base-orcamento-municipal (target has no node yet)
_dropped.why: UPDATE 2026-08-13 (AF lead-chase round): reason code changed from 'deferred' to 'note' — this is now a confirmed negative finding as of a specific date, not an open unknown awaiting a future search. A governo.cv press article (20.04.2023, quoting Minister of State/Territorial Cohesion Janine Lelis) describes a proposed revision to a distinctly-named instrument, the 'Lei Base do Orcamento Municipal' ('a proposta de revisao da Lei Base do Orcamento Municipal... esta-se tambem a introduzir os principios orcamentais que decorrem, tanto da Lei Base do Sistema Nacional de Planeamento, bem como a propria Lei Base do Orcamento do Estado'), separate from Lei n.º 79/VI/2005. The lead-chase round re-fetched the same governo.cv, 12.06.2025 article (Vice-PM/Minister of Finance Olavo Correia) and captured the fuller sentence this time: "Para o próximo ciclo, Olavo Correia defendeu que 'é urgente aprovar a Lei de Base do Orçamento Municipal, o novo Regime Financeiro dos Municípios e adotar o Índice de Coesão Territorial'" — the Minister names BOTH the 'Lei de Base do Orçamento Municipal' AND the 'novo Regime Financeiro dos Municípios' together, in present/future-obligation tense ('é urgente aprovar'), directly confirming (not merely implying, as this entry's original text had to infer from a partial quote) that NEITHER instrument had been enacted as of 12 June 2025. Separately, a full-text check of Lei n.º 52/X/2025 (Boletim Oficial I Série n.º 30, 17-04-2025; https://boe.incv.cv/Bulletins/DownloadAct?id=84886) — the only law amending Lei n.º 79/VI/2005 located in the 2025-2026 window — confirms it is not this instrument either: it amends only Article 6 (an unrelated municipal fee-charging exemption), not the FFM formula or a comprehensive municipal-budget-law revision. No enacted law number was found for the 'Lei de Base do Orçamento Municipal' or the 'novo Regime Financeiro dos Municípios' in this round's search either; that sweep of the Boletim Oficial was not exhaustive (search budget exhausted before a full 2025-2026 sweep could be completed), so a future round could still check for a later enactment. Still no node minted for either instrument for lack of a citable primary text of the enactment itself.

_dropped.why: Searched for a named-municipio breakdown of Fundo de Financiamento dos Municipios (FFM) transfers, expecting either a Ministerio das Financas transparency-portal page or an Orcamento do Estado annex. portaltransparencia.gov.cv/municipal fetched successfully but contains only a general description page with links elsewhere, no per-municipio figures. No Orcamento do Estado annex itemizing FFM transfers by named municipio was located this round; only secondary commentary (opacc.cv, anacao.cv) on the OE's fiscal-system provisions generally. The only transfer figures found (governo.cv, 12.06.2025) are national aggregates already folded into cv-lei-financas-locais-79-2005's description.

Searched for a CPLP (Comunidade dos Paises de Lingua Portuguesa)-specific citation in INE-CV's CPI methodology, on the theory it might parallel the existing AFRISTAT/COICOP treatment. Found nothing on point — results returned only Portugal's own INE cooperation newsletters (COOPSTAT) mentioning Cabo Verde in passing, not an INE-CV document naming CPLP as a methodology influence on the IPC specifically. cv-ine-ipc's existing COICOP/AFRISTAT-glossary treatment from prior rounds stands unchanged.
